test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Fitter) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Match the following designations of sheets with their respective trimmed sizes in length and breadth.

 
 

 **Designation**
 **Trimmed Size**
 
 

 A) A0
 P) 297 × 420
 
 

 B) A1
 Q) 420 × 594
 
 

 C) A2
 R) 594 × 841
 
 

 D) A3
 S) 841 × 1189
solution:
__Concept:__

There are three designations of a drawing sheet:

 
• Size series ISO - A (first choice)
 
• Special elongated sizes (Second choice)
 
• Exceptional elongated sizes (Third choice)

First choice: ISO A series

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ec1eb210fba067401398307af3789a023299b3887ccae9ac4d3ac2f7f4ff9fb.png] 

The preferred sizes of the trimmed sheets as selected from the main ISO - A series are given in table
